top_reviews.title: Good product so far
top_reviews.body: To preface: In my thirties, combo skin, minor hormonal acne, minor pore concerns on my nose, otherwise have clear and even skin tone. This product is used in conjunction with other products as part of a multistep skincare routine.I've never used an eye gel before, much less something with caffeine, so this was a change for me. I like the smell, the texture, and the packaging. It has almost a tingly/cooling sensation when you apply it and rub it in, which is a new experience. It's not painful or anything, just weird. It feels like it does a good job under my eyes, but it's too early to tell if it is going to make strides in overall puffiness or the discoloration. I've been using it for about seven days now, twice a day (once in the morning, once at night). You just need the tiniest bit. It layers really well with other stuff and doesn't have any interactions/issues with makeup. It seems to last me all day, which is great, as it has been dry and cold in my region, so my skin is staying more hydrated. For the price, I'm honestly happy with it, I think it's a good value for what you get, especially considering the care they put into it.If I notice any major changes in three months or so (allegedly when you start to notice changes from skin care), then I'll update this review. :)

top_reviews.title: Puffy eyes, This will fix it within seconds!
top_reviews.body: Ok I have such sensitive skin that it reacts to almost anything creamy applied. But this, this is AMAZING. I previously for years spent money on a high end skincare brand due to my sensitive skin and although it worked wonders it unfortunately isn't in the budget for me now. So a friend told me to tey this about a year ago and I am here to say I have ONLY used this for a year and I apply after washing my face in mornings to help fine lines/puffiness/wrinkles under my eyes. Yall within a couple seconds your skin will be firm and the puffiness is gone. For the price and quality is was shocked. I have been a past gate keeper of this but I know times is hard for alot and if you have any of the issues I listed then get this and thank me later. I promise it's that good and works so quickly. Also I apply my makeup over it and it still does a great job. There is no scent and the size may be small but a little bit goes a long ways. The tube last me about 4-6 months. Its blends evenly into the skin and isn't sticky or nothing. Very moisturizing and also brightens under my eyes.

top_reviews.title: Nice, thick moisturizer
top_reviews.body: I bought this in July and have waited until I've nearly finished my first tube in February (!!) to write the review; I wanted to really see how well it did before speaking on it.It has a nice, thick, smooth texture and glides easily over the skin around the eyes. Takes a little while to absorb fully. I do notice a good moisturizing effect from it, but no reduction in wrinkles/crow's feet, no tightening of skin, and no lightening of undereye circles.I would buy it again to use as an inexpensive eye cream if I wasn't specifically looking for the other benefits - it is a very nice cream for the price, especially considering how long the tube lasts.

top_reviews.title: Refreshing Eye Gel That Really Wakes Up Tired Eyes
top_reviews.body: I’ve been using the Good Molecules Yerba Mate Wake Up Eye Gel for a few weeks now, and it has quickly become a staple in my morning routine. This lightweight eye gel is refreshing, hydrating, and genuinely helps reduce the appearance of tired eyes.Texture & Application:The gel has a lightweight, smooth texture that absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky or greasy residue. A small amount goes a long way, and it spreads evenly under the eyes. It feels cooling on contact, which makes it perfect for mornings or after a long night.Hydration & Brightening:Formulated with hyaluronic acid and yerba mate extract, this eye gel provides noticeable hydration. My under-eye area feels plump and moisturized throughout the day, and I’ve noticed a subtle reduction in puffiness and dullness. While it doesn’t eliminate dark circles entirely, it definitely brightens the under-eye area and gives a more awake, refreshed appearance.Gentle & Effective:I have sensitive skin around my eyes, and I’ve experienced no irritation, stinging, or redness. The gentle formula makes it suitable for daily use, and it layers well under makeup or sunscreen without pilling.Packaging:The product comes in a sturdy, no-fuss tube that dispenses the right amount of gel without waste. The design is simple and hygienic, which I appreciate for an eye product.Final Thoughts:The Good Molecules Yerba Mate Wake Up Eye Gel is a lightweight, hydrating, and refreshing eye treatment that really helps with puffiness and tired-looking eyes. If you’re looking for a gentle daily eye gel that keeps the under-eye area hydrated and energized, this is a fantastic choice.
